remarks: This charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath ranch-style condo offers low-maintenance living in a great location near downtown. Step into a spacious living room featuring a bright picture windows that fill the space with natural light. The kitchen, though compact, is thoughtfully designed for efficiency and convenience. A cozy bedroom provides a relaxing retreat, while the full bath provides the perfect place for winding down. Enjoy the added benefit of on-site laundry and the ease of single-level living. Ideally located just moments from vibrant downtown bars and restaurants, multiple scenic beaches, and with quick access to I-95, this home is a commuter's dream-New York City is just 60 minutes away. This condo offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Schedule today!
